argv:
A Meridian-3 has stopped reporting. How long can it keep working
offline, and how would I detect that from the Fleet Control API?

parsed.answer:
A Meridian-3 can keep working offline for up to **12 minutes** (the offline autonomy window). At the end of that window — or when its buffered task queue is exhausted, whichever comes first — it performs a safe-park and holds position until the link is restored. [sample_corpus/product-specs.md:Acme Robotics — Product Specifications > Meridian-3 Autonomous Mobile Robot > Offline Autonomy]

To detect this from the Fleet Control API:

1. **Watch `link_state`**: when no report has been received for more than 30 seconds, `link_state` flips to `"offline"` and the `robot.link_lost` webhook fires. [sample_corpus/api-reference.md:Fleet Control API Reference > Fleet Telemetry > GET /robots/{robot_id}/telemetry] [sample_corpus/faq.md:Frequently Asked Questions > Fleet Operations > What happens during a network outage?]

2. **Monitor `offline_seconds`**: poll `GET /robots/{robot_id}/telemetry` and watch `offline_seconds` climb. Once it crosses the 12-minute autonomy window, you can assume a safe-park has almost certainly occurred — Fleet Control does not decide this itself, the robot does on board. [sample_corpus/api-reference.md:Fleet Control API Reference > Fleet Telemetry > GET /robots/{robot_id}/telemetry] [sample_corpus/support-runbook.md:Support Runbook > Many Robots Offline at Once]

3. **On reconnect**: you will receive a `robot.link_restored` event followed by a `robot.safe_parked` event, and the `beacon` field will read `"amber"` if the robot did park. [sample_corpus/faq.md:Frequently Asked Questions > Fleet Operations > What happens during a network outage?]

4. **Amber beacon persistence**: if the beacon stays amber for more than a minute after reconnect, a physical check is needed. [sample_corpus/faq.md:Frequently Asked Questions > Fleet Operations > What happens during a network outage?] [sample_corpus/support-runbook.md:Support Runbook > Many Robots Offline at Once]
